### Backlash — Fallout: Equestria: Merchants of Hope

Backlash is Gamma Deekay’s **earth-pony wasteland merchant and mechanic**, the lead of *Fallout Equestria: Merchants of Hope*. He travels with his adopted pegasus sister and business partner **Skyline**, uncovering a pre-war Ministry of Morale secret connected to his ancestry. He is a character in this particular fan-written Fallout: Equestria side-story continuity, not an identified character from the *Friendship Is Magic* television show.

**Recognize him:** Tan coat; half-brown, half-gold mane and tail; golden eyes; two red gear wheels for a cutie mark (one darker and smaller); a stockier build and worn off-white saddlebags. Later he gains a distinctive **pink PipBuck** and an olive-drab flak jacket. His mechanical skill and nervous, impulsive temperament are central to his characterization.

**Name and story:** “Backlash” is his name in the original fan story, not an episode name or a later fandom nickname. The fan wiki associates his gear-themed design with the mechanical term *backlash*, and says the gear cutie mark was designed first. Within *Merchants of Hope*, he discovers that he descends from **Pinkie Pie** and becomes **acting chief of operations of the Ministry of Morale**—a position, not a secret identity. His travels involve Skyline, Brass Tacks, Carlotta and Yew Longbow; his actions inadvertently release the threat called **42**.

**Speaking/appearances:** He has written dialogue in the 2013–14 fanfiction; no verified animated-series appearance or official voice actor. A community audiobook by **Plagen Shiki** exists, but its narrator is not an official character casting credit.

**Images:** No Backlash-specific artwork/post with verifiable artist attribution and a confirmed direct HTTPS image URL was found. No unrelated Fallout: Equestria pony image is substituted.
